problem.explanation: WHERE filters rows before the name projection is returned. ORDER BY makes the result stable. A common mistake is using a partial match that includes unintended departments. In a normalized design this filter might use department_id joined to a departments table.
hints: Filter the department column with an exact text comparison.
Project only name and add ORDER BY name.
problem.reference_solution: SELECT name FROM employees WHERE department = 'Engineering' ORDER BY name
problem.statement_markdown: Return the names of employees in the Engineering department. Sort names alphabetically.
problem.title: Employees in department
